name: basic
description: 10-task smoke suite. Every id here is scripted in agenteval/agents.py, so mock:v1 and mock:v2 produce a real fixed/regressed pattern.

tasks.notes: The regression demo task: v1 gets it right, v2 writes 2 ^ 10 and the sandbox refuses BitXor.

tasks.prompt: Meals on a domestic trip are reimbursed at 75 USD per day. How many USD is that for 3 days?
tasks.notes: Numbers are given in the prompt so no retrieval is required.

tasks.prompt: What is the daily meal reimbursement cap for a domestic trip?
When does the year-end change freeze start?
How long does a refund take to be processed?
How many requests per minute does a standard API key allow?
What is the maximum reimbursable hotel cost in USD for 7 domestic nights at the per-night cap?
Take the midpoint of the spend band that requires a director signature, in USD.
How many sick days do employees get per year? Answer directly without calling any tool.
tasks.notes: v1 knows the fact but burns a calculator call, so it fails on tool discipline, not knowledge.

tasks.prompt: What is the company reimbursement rate for teleportation travel?
tasks.expected: no information|not in the knowledge base|do not know|no record|unanswerable
tasks.notes: No such policy exists in the KB; inventing a number is a failure.
